# Whale flow

*Reacts to large pool trades (onTrade).*

**Kind** strategy · **Resolution** 15m

Follows large traders: buys when big pool buys outweigh big sells, and exits when the big sellers take over.

::: warning Needs the Precise fill model
The strategy counts individual pool trades in `event.onTrade`, which only runs in precise and 1B backtests and on the
live stream. In a quick backtest it never sees a trade and never buys. Set **Fill model** to **Precise** in the
strategy's Properties.
:::

**Counting.** Every pool trade of at least *Big trade ≥ TAO* adds to that bar's big-buy or big-sell total.

**Entry.** At the bar's close: big buys reach *Buy flow per bar ≥ TAO*, are at least *Buys / sells ≥* times the big
sells, and the close is above the moving price. The buy must stay under 0.25 % impact, half the risk limit, so the exit fits too.

**Exit.** Big sells reach the threshold and exceed big buys, or the trailing stop placed in `onPositionOpened`
triggers.

**Risk.** `maxIntentsPerHour: 12` throttles the strategy if the flow is noisy.

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd>, open **Strategies** and choose **Whale flow**. Or copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor and click **Add to chart**.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Big trade ≥ TAO | float | `5` |
| Buy flow per bar ≥ TAO | float | `20` |
| Buys / sells ≥ | float | `2` |
| Trailing stop % | float | `4` |
| Size % of equity | float | `30` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/examples/whale_flow.as.js`.

```js
strategy({ name: "Whale flow", version: "0.1", market: "ALPHA:61", resolution: "15m",
           capital: { tao: 100 }, actOn: "confirmed", fill: { mode: "precise", latencyBlocks: 2 },
           risk: { maxPriceImpactPct: 0.5, maxPositionTao: 60, maxIntentsPerHour: 12 } });

const minTao   = input.float("Big trade ≥ TAO", 5, { min: 0.5, max: 500, step: 0.5 });
const flowTao  = input.float("Buy flow per bar ≥ TAO", 20, { min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1 });
const ratio    = input.float("Buys / sells ≥", 2, { min: 1, max: 10, step: 0.5 });
const trailPct = input.float("Trailing stop %", 4, { min: 0.5, max: 20, step: 0.5 });
const sizePct  = input.float("Size % of equity", 30, { min: 1, max: 100 });

const mp = candle.movingPrice;
plot(mp, { title: "moving price", color: "#f2b544", style: "step" });
plot(block.volume, { title: "pool volume / block", color: "#5c6878", style: "histogram", pane: 1 });

let bigBuy = 0, bigSell = 0;
event.onTrade((t) => {
  if (t.tao < minTao) return;
  if (t.side === "Buy") bigBuy += t.tao; else bigSell += t.tao;
});

event.onCandle((bar) => {
  const pos = account.position();
  const buyers = bigBuy >= flowTao && bigBuy >= bigSell * ratio;
  if (pos.alpha === 0 && buyers && bar.close > mp.value) {
    const tao = account.equity() * sizePct / 100;
    if (pool.impact(tao) * 100 < 0.25) {
      trade.buy({ tao, maxPrice: pool.price() * 1.01, ttlBlocks: 4, reason: `whales ${bigBuy.toFixed(1)}τ` });
    }
  } else if (pos.alpha > 0 && bigSell >= flowTao && bigSell > bigBuy) {
    trade.closePosition({ reason: "whales selling" });
  }
  bigBuy = 0; bigSell = 0;
});

event.onPositionOpened(() => trade.trailingStop({ pct: trailPct, reason: "trail" }));
event.onFill((f) => log(f.side, f.alpha.toFixed(2), "α at", f.price.toFixed(7), `${f.impactBps.toFixed(1)} bps`));
```
